# Cod

<section class="hmi-quick-read" id="cod-quick-read" data-hmi-quick-read aria-labelledby="cod-quick-read-label"><div class="hmi-quick-read-label" id="cod-quick-read-label">Quick read</div>

Cod carries low lead, cadmium, mercury, nickel, and aluminum, with salted and dried cod higher than fresh or frozen fillets.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Witczak A, Ciemniak A, Wiecaszek B, Keszka S, Protasowicki M, Pokorska-Niewiada K · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">An Assessment of the Public Health Risk Associated with Consumption of Imported Fish Based on the Intake of Essential and Harmful Elements</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Molecules 2025, 30, 3836</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Total arsenic is the largest value, but it was never speciated.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span →</a></span></span></sup>

<p>Mercury and cadmium are the metals with EU fish limits that cod comes nearest to, and only in dried or salted forms.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels|4]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">European Commission · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels">Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/915 of 25 April 2023 on maximum levels for certain contaminants in food and repealing Regulation (EC) No 1881/2006</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Official Journal of the European Union</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Lead stayed below the 4 µg/kg reporting limit in every US baked cod composite.<sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup></p>

<p>Drying and salting raise values per kilogram, and species substitution is common in products sold as cod.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup></p>

<p>Aluminum has one study and inorganic arsenic has none.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Witczak A, Ciemniak A, Wiecaszek B, Keszka S, Protasowicki M, Pokorska-Niewiada K · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">An Assessment of the Public Health Risk Associated with Consumption of Imported Fish Based on the Intake of Essential and Harmful Elements</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Molecules 2025, 30, 3836</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">Read source →</a></span></span></sup></p>

<a id="cod-overview"></a>
<a id="decision-summary"></a>
## Cod overview

<a id="hmi-ing-004"></a>
<a id="which-contamination-concerns-are-supported-for-this-ingredient-and-its-defined-forms"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-005"></a>
<a id="which-sourcing-or-production-decisions-deserve-priority-on-the-available-evidence"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-006"></a>
<a id="which-evidence-gaps-most-limit-those-decisions"></a>

Cod on this page is the muscle of true cod and the whitefish products sold under the cod name, eaten fresh, frozen, breaded, salted, or dried. Across three source families, cod carries low lead, cadmium, mercury, nickel, and aluminum and a much larger amount of total arsenic, most of which is not inorganic arsenic.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Witczak A, Ciemniak A, Wiecaszek B, Keszka S, Protasowicki M, Pokorska-Niewiada K · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">An Assessment of the Public Health Risk Associated with Consumption of Imported Fish Based on the Intake of Essential and Harmful Elements</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Molecules 2025, 30, 3836</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

The salted and dried forms carry the highest values for nearly every metal, and the fresh and frozen fillets carry the lowest.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Imported frozen Pacific cod averaged 11 µg/kg lead, 10 µg/kg cadmium, 31 µg/kg total mercury, 100 µg/kg nickel, and 140 µg/kg aluminum, wet weight.<sup class="cite">[[sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Witczak A, Ciemniak A, Wiecaszek B, Keszka S, Protasowicki M, Pokorska-Niewiada K · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">An Assessment of the Public Health Risk Associated with Consumption of Imported Fish Based on the Intake of Essential and Harmful Elements</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Molecules 2025, 30, 3836</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>



<a id="ingredient-identity-and-scope"></a>
## What counts as cod

<a id="hmi-ing-001"></a>
<a id="what-commodity-biological-species-edible-part-and-commercial-forms-does-this-page-cover"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-002"></a>
<a id="which-processing-states-and-derivatives-are-distinct-materials-rather-than-synonyms"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-003"></a>
<a id="what-evidence-can-be-transferred-between-those-materials-and-what-requires-a-separate-answer"></a>

True cod are Gadus species such as Atlantic cod (Gadus morhua) and Pacific cod (Gadus macrocephalus).<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Witczak A, Ciemniak A, Wiecaszek B, Keszka S, Protasowicki M, Pokorska-Niewiada K · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">An Assessment of the Public Health Risk Associated with Consumption of Imported Fish Based on the Intake of Essential and Harmful Elements</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Molecules 2025, 30, 3836</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> In the Italian retail survey, eight of ten products labeled or sold as cod were hake, Alaska pollock, or saithe, and only the stockfish and the baccala were Gadus morhua.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

This page reports each product under its stated species and form and does not pool the substitutes with true cod.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Salted cod (baccala) and air dried cod (stockfish) are separate forms, because drying and salting change the weight basis of every result.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

<a id="heavy-metal-contamination-profile"></a>
## Heavy metal contamination profile of cod

<a id="hmi-ing-007"></a>
<a id="which-metals-and-chemical-species-have-been-investigated-in-this-ingredient"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-008"></a>
<a id="what-concentrations-detection-frequencies-and-variability-were-observed-in-each-defined-sampling-frame"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-009"></a>
<a id="which-analyte-questions-are-unassessed-access-blocked-conflicting-or-searched-without-eligible-evidence"></a>

Frozen Pacific cod imported from China into Poland, 130 fish in 13 batches, averaged 11 µg/kg lead, 10 µg/kg cadmium, 31 µg/kg total mercury, 160 µg/kg total arsenic, 100 µg/kg nickel, 140 µg/kg aluminum, and 80 µg/kg chromium, wet weight.<sup class="cite">[[sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Witczak A, Ciemniak A, Wiecaszek B, Keszka S, Protasowicki M, Pokorska-Niewiada K · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">An Assessment of the Public Health Risk Associated with Consumption of Imported Fish Based on the Intake of Essential and Harmful Elements</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Molecules 2025, 30, 3836</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> In 27 baked cod composites from the US Total Diet Study, collected from 2017 to 2020, total arsenic ranged from 1,300 to 10,900 µg/kg and total mercury from 44 to 140 µg/kg.<sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

Lead was below the 4 µg/kg reporting limit in all 27 baked cod composites, cadmium was detected in 16 of 27 at up to 11 µg/kg, and nickel was detected once, at 46 µg/kg.<sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> In the Italian survey, the baccala held 80 µg/kg lead, 60 µg/kg cadmium, 270 µg/kg total mercury, 800 µg/kg total arsenic, and 20 µg/kg nickel, as sold.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

<div class="hmi-analyte-explorer" id="hmi-occurrence-cod" data-analyte-explorer data-compact-intro="true" data-source-summaries="true"><details class="hmi-drawer-disclosure" data-explorer-context><summary data-open-context aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="hmi-occurrence-cod-drawer">Comparison methods and scope</summary><div data-explorer-context-content>

<p>Each row is one statistic a source reports for one form of cod, group and metal; percentiles, ranges and maxima reported for the same samples as a mean or median are shown on that row. Different forms and preparation states are kept apart, and dry-weight results never share a reference with as-sold or fresh-weight results. Ratings place a result against an HMI reference built from monitoring results and ordinary-setting medians for the same form and basis. Same-study contrasts compare a contaminated or treated site with its control, targeted with random sampling, a prepared form with the unprocessed one, or one group of a study with the median of its other groups. Counts describe evidence units, not independent studies or certainty.</p><div class="hmi-drawer-table"><table><thead><tr><th scope="col">Contributing family</th><th scope="col">Reference units</th><th scope="col">Weight</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>FDA Total Diet Study</td><td>27</td><td>100%</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Methods</p><p>HMI pools subgroup medians for cod, cooked on a as sold, as eaten or fresh weight basis: monitoring results summarized as one median per reporting region, sampling type and collection year, total diet composites and printed sample values as single observations, and printed subgroup medians from ordinary farms or markets. Each sampling family has equal total weight. Non-detects stay as zero-to-limit intervals, so quartiles carry lower and upper bounds. Means, ranges and maxima never enter as observations. Other forms, other bases, targeted sampling and results from mining, industrial, wastewater-affected, experimental, fertiliser or manufacturer settings are kept out of this reference.</p><p>Inverse weighted empirical CDF; midpoint at exact cumulative-weight boundaries. At least four reference units and a definitely positive Q1–Q3 spread are required. This is a display eligibility rule, not statistical validation.</p><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Limitations</p><p>FDA Total Diet Study is the only compatible sampling family for cod, cooked on this basis in the completed cod ledger, so this single-family reference cannot represent other markets. Reporting regions and purchase markets are not growing areas. Non-detects with differing limits widen the bounds. A position is descriptive concentration, not a safety or compliance judgment.</p><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Admitted source families</p><ul><li><a href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020" class="internal" data-slug="sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020" data-no-cite-meta>FDA Total Diet Study</a></li></ul><details class="hmi-drawer-disclosure"><summary>Reference version and interpretation</summary><p>Frozen evidence selection: 2026-10-22. <a id="sources-and-contamination-pathways"></a>
## How metals reach cod

<a id="hmi-ing-010"></a>
<a id="what-evidence-supports-root-uptake-surface-deposition-feed-transfer-or-other-biological-pathways"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-011"></a>
<a id="what-contamination-can-arise-from-agricultural-inputs-harvesting-processing-equipment-or-packaging"></a>
<a id="hmi-ing-012"></a>
<a id="which-source-attribution-claims-are-measured-modelled-inferred-or-unresolved"></a>

Cod take up metals from seawater, sediment, and prey, and the studies here report the levels in the muscle that is eaten rather than tracing each route.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Witczak A, Ciemniak A, Wiecaszek B, Keszka S, Protasowicki M, Pokorska-Niewiada K · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">An Assessment of the Public Health Risk Associated with Consumption of Imported Fish Based on the Intake of Essential and Harmful Elements</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Molecules 2025, 30, 3836</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

Arsenic in marine fish is mostly organic, and none of these sources measured inorganic arsenic, so the total arsenic values cannot be read as inorganic arsenic.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, ## Which forms and regions measured lower

<a id="hmi-ing-013"></a>

Product form drives most of the spread in the retail survey, with the stockfish and baccala above every fresh, frozen, and breaded product for lead, cadmium, mercury, arsenic, and nickel.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

Among the hake, pollock, and saithe products, lead ranged from 10 to 50 µg/kg, total mercury was 10 µg/kg except 80 µg/kg in fresh European hake, and nickel stayed below quantification.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

The US baked cod composites span four collection regions and both regional and national lists, and total arsenic varied about eightfold across them.<sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> The Polish study does not report collection years, so its results cannot be placed in time.<sup class="cite">[[sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Witczak A, Ciemniak A, Wiecaszek B, Keszka S, Protasowicki M, Pokorska-Niewiada K · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">An Assessment of the Public Health Risk Associated with Consumption of Imported Fish Based on the Intake of Essential and Harmful Elements</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Molecules 2025, 30, 3836</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

Drying and salting remove water, so metals measured in stockfish and baccala are concentrated relative to fresh muscle, and the as sold values are not directly comparable with fresh fillets.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Breaded and battered sticks and burgers in the Italian survey carried 50 µg/kg lead, which is above most of the plain fillets in the same survey.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

Baking also concentrates the muscle by losing water, which is one reason the US composites are reported as prepared rather than as sold.<sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

For salted cod, soaking before cooking is a common practice, but no cited source measured its effect on metals, so this page makes no claim about it.

<p class="hmi-mitigation-gap" data-mitigation-gap>No study in this library has yet measured a way to lower heavy metals in cod; the results above show the levels measured, and lot testing against the applicable limit remains the verifiable check.</p>

Buyers should confirm the species on the label or by testing, since most products sold as cod in the Italian survey were other whitefish.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Specifications for dried or salted cod should state whether results are as sold or rehydrated, because the basis changes the number.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

The EU maximum levels for fish muscle are 300 µg/kg lead, 50 µg/kg cadmium, and 300 µg/kg mercury for Atlantic cod.<sup class="cite">[[sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels|4]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">European Commission · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels">Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/915 of 25 April 2023 on maximum levels for certain contaminants in food and repealing Regulation (EC) No 1881/2006</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Official Journal of the European Union</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

The cod evidence covers all six priority metals, but aluminum rests on one study and arsenic is reported only as total arsenic.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2022</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">FY2018-FY2020 TDS Elements Analytical Results</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">FDA Total Diet Study</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020">Read source →</a></span></span></sup><sup class="cite">[[sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Witczak A, Ciemniak A, Wiecaszek B, Keszka S, Protasowicki M, Pokorska-Niewiada K · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">An Assessment of the Public Health Risk Associated with Consumption of Imported Fish Based on the Intake of Essential and Harmful Elements</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Molecules 2025, 30, 3836</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

No source tested Atlantic cod fillets directly, and only two Gadus morhua products were measured, so the Atlantic cod picture is thin.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

References identify the sources used in these answers. The Sources index preserves additional discovery links; inclusion there does not mean a source has been reviewed for this assessment. Corrections, completed searches, new direct evidence and changes in requirements should reopen the relevant answer.

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="how-much-mercury-is-in-cod" data-anchor="how-much-mercury-is-in-cod" data-question="How much mercury is in cod?">

<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="is-the-arsenic-in-cod-dangerous" data-anchor="is-the-arsenic-in-cod-dangerous" data-question="Is the arsenic in cod dangerous?">

Cod carries total arsenic of 160 µg/kg in frozen Pacific cod and 1,300 to 10,900 µg/kg in baked US composites.<sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|3]]<span <details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="does-cod-contain-lead" data-anchor="does-cod-contain-lead" data-question="Does cod contain lead?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Does cod contain lead?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Lead averaged 11 µg/kg in frozen Pacific cod and was below the 4 µg/kg reporting limit in all 27 US baked cod composites.<sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|3]]<span Cadmium averaged 10 µg/kg in frozen Pacific cod and reached 11 µg/kg in US baked composites.<sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2022-tds-elements-fy2018-fy2020|3]]<span class="cite-card"><span <details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="has-aluminum-been-measured-in-cod" data-anchor="has-aluminum-been-measured-in-cod" data-question="Has aluminum been measured in cod?">

Nickel averaged 100 µg/kg in frozen Pacific cod.<sup class="cite">[[sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span <details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="is-salted-or-dried-cod-higher-in-metals-than-fresh-cod" data-anchor="is-salted-or-dried-cod-higher-in-metals-than-fresh-cod" data-question="Is salted or dried cod higher in metals than fresh cod?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Is salted or dried cod higher in metals than fresh cod?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Yes, in the Italian survey baccala and stockfish carried the highest lead, cadmium, mercury, arsenic, and nickel of all ten products.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> Part of this reflects water loss, since the values are as sold.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="is-the-fish-sold-as-cod-always-true-cod" data-anchor="is-the-fish-sold-as-cod-always-true-cod" data-question="Is the fish sold as cod always true cod?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Is the fish sold as cod always true cod?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

No, eight of ten Italian retail products sold as cod were hake, Alaska pollock, or saithe.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Nava V, Potortì AG, Lo Turco V, Spanò IM, Sturniolo R, Di Bella G · 2026</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Safety of Commercial Cod Products and Potential Impact on Consumers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Foods 2026, 15, 1202</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="does-processing-change-heavy-metals-in-cod" data-anchor="does-processing-change-heavy-metals-in-cod" data-question="Does processing change heavy metals in cod?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>Does processing change heavy metals in cod?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Drying, salting, and baking remove water and raise the concentration per kilogram.<sup class="cite">[[sources/nava2026-messina-cod-products-elements|1]]<span class="cite-card"><span <details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="what-limits-apply-to-metals-in-cod" data-anchor="what-limits-apply-to-metals-in-cod" data-question="What limits apply to metals in cod?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>What limits apply to metals in cod?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

The EU sets 300 µg/kg lead, 50 µg/kg cadmium, and 300 µg/kg mercury for Atlantic cod muscle.<sup class="cite">[[sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels|4]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">European Commission · 2023</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels">Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/915 of 25 April 2023 on maximum levels for certain contaminants in food and repealing Regulation (EC) No 1881/2006</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Official Journal of the European Union</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/eu-2023-915-contaminants-maximum-levels">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="what-should-a-cod-test-report" data-anchor="what-should-a-cod-test-report" data-question="What should a cod test report?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>What should a cod test report?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

It should report lead, cadmium, total mercury, speciated arsenic, nickel, and aluminum with a stated basis and quantification limits near a few µg/kg.<sup class="cite">[[sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland|2]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">Witczak A, Ciemniak A, Wiecaszek B, Keszka S, Protasowicki M, Pokorska-Niewiada K · 2025</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">An Assessment of the Public Health Risk Associated with Consumption of Imported Fish Based on the Intake of Essential and Harmful Elements</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">Molecules 2025, 30, 3836</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/witczak2025-imported-fish-elements-poland">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>
